svg.title: Binary Search Tree
svg.desc: Binary Search Tree. Smaller keys left, larger right: O(log n) search and insert while the tree stays balanced, O(n) once it degrades into a list. Step 1, Smaller left, larger right: Each new key starts at the root and goes left if smaller, right if larger, until a spot is empty. Step 2, Search, insert at a miss: Search 60: found in 3 comparisons. Search 65 ends at 60's empty right child, so 65 attaches there. Step 3, In-order is sorted: In-order (left subtree, node, right subtree) emits the keys sorted: 20 30 40 50 60 65 70 80. Step 4, Balance is everything: Sorted inserts build a chain 8 levels deep: finding 80 takes 8 comparisons instead of 3.
